answerModes.title: Answer modes
answerModes.intro: Each QCM has an answer mode defined at creation. It determines how questions are presented during the practice session.

single.label: Single answer
single.desc: All questions have exactly one correct answer. Options are displayed as radio buttons.

multiple.label: Multiple answers
multiple.desc: Questions can have several correct answers. Options are displayed as checkboxes.

mixed.label: Mixed
mixed.desc: Each question has its own configuration (single or multiple answer), defined by the contributor.

answerModes.scoringDesc: For a multiple-answer question, all correct answers must be selected. A partial selection (even if all chosen answers are correct) is counted as a wrong answer.

import.title: Import QCMs
import.intro: When creating a QCM, you can upload a JSON or CSV file directly instead of filling in the form manually. The file is validated client-side then verified server-side before being pre-filled into the form — you can then review and submit.
import.jsonDesc: The file must be a JSON array containing a QCM object. All text fields use the format {"fr": "...", "en": "..."}. The correctAnswer field accepts a string for a single answer or a string array for multiple correct answers.
import.csvDesc: The CSV file uses one row per question. Metadata columns (title, description, topic) are repeated on each row but only the values from the first row are used. The _en columns can be left empty for a French-only QCM. Note: CSV only supports single answers — use JSON for multiple answers.
rules: The "title" and "description" fields must have at least one translation (fr or en).
The "topic" field must be one of: scrum, devops, safe.
The "answerMode" field (optional) must be: single, multiple or mixed. Default: single.
Each question must have between 2 and 4 options. Ids a and b are required; c and d are optional.
"correctAnswer" can be a string ("b") for a single answer, or an array (["a","c"]) for multiple answers.
"isMultiple: true" means the user must select all correct answers. A partial selection is counted as wrong.
The QCM must contain at least one question and at most 40 questions.
In CSV, one row = one question. Metadata (title, description, topic) are repeated on each row.
The "_en" columns can be left empty for a French-only QCM (and vice versa).
Note: CSV only supports single answers. Use JSON for multiple answers.

prompt.title: Generate with AI
prompt.desc: Paste this prompt into ChatGPT, Claude or any other chatbot, then attach your file or paste your questions below.
prompt.text:
You are a QCM conversion assistant. I will provide you with multiple-choice questions in any format (plain text, image, PDF, etc.).

Your task is to convert them into valid JSON following the schema below, without ever paraphrasing or rewording the questions or answers — copy them word for word.

Convention for correct answers: in my file, the correct answer is preceded by the letter "V" at the beginning of the line. For multiple-answer questions, several lines start with "V".

Conversion rules:
- Copy question and answer texts exactly as-is, without any rewording.
- If the content is in French only, provide a faithful English translation in the "en" field. If the content is in English only, translate to French in the "fr" field.
- Option ids are "a", "b", "c", "d" in order of appearance.
- If a question contains an instruction such as "Select one or more choices.", "Sélectionnez un ou plusieurs choix." or any similar variant, do NOT include it in the question text: this instruction is displayed automatically by the application.
- "correctAnswer" is the letter of the correct option ("a", "b", "c" or "d"). If multiple answers are correct, it is an array (e.g. ["a", "c"]) and "isMultiple" is true.
- "answerMode" is "single" if all questions have one answer, "multiple" if all have several, "mixed" otherwise.
- Follow the JSON schema below exactly. Return only raw JSON, no comments or explanations.

Schema:
[
  {
    "title": { "fr": "Titre du QCM", "en": "QCM title" },
    "description": { "fr": "Description courte", "en": "Short description" },
    "topic": "devops",
    "answerMode": "single",
    "isPrivate": false,
    "questions": [
      {
        "text": { "fr": "Texte de la question ?", "en": "Question text?" },
        "options": [
          { "id": "a", "text": { "fr": "Option A", "en": "Option A" } },
          { "id": "b", "text": { "fr": "Option B", "en": "Option B" } },
          { "id": "c", "text": { "fr": "Option C", "en": "Option C" } },
          { "id": "d", "text": { "fr": "Option D", "en": "Option D" } }
        ],
        "correctAnswer": "b",
        "isMultiple": false
      }
    ]
  }
]
